## Details

<a id="move_return_flags"></a>
### [`move_return_flags`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables.asm#L9) `$115B-$1173`

*data*

Move table, one byte per move $00-$18. Bit 7 keeps the input of the move; nonzero lets the move return to the stance by itself.

- **Read by:** [`move_update_state`](../fighter/fighter_moves.md#move_update_state), [`move_anim_end`](../fighter/fighter_moves.md#move_anim_end)

<a id="move_attack_flags"></a>
### [`move_attack_flags`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables.asm#L15) `$1174-$118C`

*data*

Move table: 1 for the 11 attack moves ($06, $07, $0a-$11, $18).

- **Read by:** [`ai_update`](../ai/ai_opponent.md#ai_update), [`fighter_update`](../fighter/fighter_moves.md#fighter_update), [`move_fix_input`](../fighter/fighter_moves.md#move_fix_input), [`hit_check`](../fighter/hit_test.md#hit_check)

<a id="move_counter_moves"></a>
### [`move_counter_moves`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables.asm#L21) `$118D-$11A5`

*data*

Move table: the block or dodge that answers each attack move, 0 for none.

- **Read by:** [`ai_update`](../ai/ai_opponent.md#ai_update), [`move_fix_input`](../fighter/fighter_moves.md#move_fix_input)

<a id="move_reach_types"></a>
### [`move_reach_types`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables.asm#L27) `$11A6-$11BA`

*data*

Move table of 21 bytes: reach type of the attack. Moves $15-$18 read the first 4 bytes of the next table, which are 0.

- **Read by:** [`hit_test`](../fighter/hit_test.md#hit_test), [`hit_range_test`](../fighter/hit_test.md#hit_range_test)

<a id="move_full_reach"></a>
### [`move_full_reach`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables.asm#L32) `$11BB-$11D3`

*data*

Move table: reach value for a full point of the attack.

- **Read by:** [`hit_test`](../fighter/hit_test.md#hit_test)

<a id="move_half_reach"></a>
### [`move_half_reach`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables.asm#L38) `$11D4-$11EC`

*data*

Move table: reach value for a half point of the attack.

- **Read by:** [`hit_test`](../fighter/hit_test.md#hit_test)

<a id="move_flags_unreferenced"></a>
### [`move_flags_unreferenced`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables.asm#L44) `$11ED-$1201`

*data*

Table of 21 bytes with 1 for moves $07, $0a, $0b, $0c and $11. No instruction indexes it; a read with a large index reaches $11ed and $11f4.

<a id="move_hit_frames"></a>
### [`move_hit_frames`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables.asm#L49) `$1202-$121A`

*data*

Move table: the shape frame of the attack that does the hit test.

- **Read by:** [`hit_check`](../fighter/hit_test.md#hit_check)

<a id="move_hit_zone_facing"></a>
### [`move_hit_zone_facing`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables.asm#L55) `$121B-$124C`

*data*

Move table of words: hit zone table of the attack when the fighters face each other, 0 for no attack.

- **Read by:** [`hit_test`](../fighter/hit_test.md#hit_test)

<a id="move_hit_zone_same_facing"></a>
### [`move_hit_zone_same_facing`](../../../../src/game/entry_and_tables.asm#L64) `$124D-$127E`

*data*

Move table of words: hit zone table of the attack when both fighters face the same way.

- **Read by:** [`hit_test`](../fighter/hit_test.md#hit_test)
